headline: Law Minister: Next national election will be held under caretaker government
summary: Law Minister Md Asaduzzaman stated that the caretaker system is a political commitment and the result of a previous movement.
details: Law Minister Md Asaduzzaman has announced that the next national parliamentary election will be held under a caretaker government.

The statement was made to journalists at the Secretariat after the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court dismissed appeals challenging the High Court verdict on the 15th amendment to the constitution.
The Law Minister described the return to a caretaker government as a political commitment, noting that the system was originally the result of the BNP's movement.
The 15th amendment, passed during the Awami League government's tenure, had previously abolished the caretaker government system.
This amendment was one of the most controversial constitutional changes in the country's history and led to significant political controversy.

The 15th amendment, passed during the Awami League government's tenure, had previously abolished the caretaker government system.

headline_marked: 2 children [[killed in Chakaria landslide]] amid heavy rain
headline: 2 children killed in Chakaria landslide amid heavy rain
summary: The tragedy occurred in Cox's Bazar when a hillside collapsed onto a residential home while the children were sleeping.
details: Two children were killed after a landslide hit a residential house in Chakaria, Cox's Bazar, during a period of heavy rainfall.
The incident occurred while the children were sleeping inside their home, which was crushed by the collapsing hillside.
Local authorities and emergency responders rushed to the scene to recover the bodies from the debris.
The landslide was triggered by continuous heavy rain in the region, which often makes the hilly terrain unstable and prone to such disasters.
caption:
Two children lost their lives in an instant while they slept.

Two children were killed after a landslide hit a residential house in Chakaria, Cox's Bazar, during a period of heavy rainfall.

The incident occurred while the children were sleeping inside their home, which was crushed by the collapsing hillside.

Local authorities and emergency responders rushed to the scene to recover the bodies from the debris.

The landslide was triggered by continuous heavy rain in the region, which often makes the hilly terrain unstable and prone to such disasters.
